groups.sentence: Instructors and units adopt and apply the recommended guidance and considerations.
These policies provide a framework for the responsible and ethical use of AI.
AI is spreading rapidly, bringing both opportunities and risks to education.
The guidance offers a shared starting point and language to support community discussion and decisions about AI.
These policies set requirements and expectations for acceptable AI use that the community must follow.
These policies offer guidance to help faculty and instructors handle AI in teaching.
These policies aim to protect institutional data and reduce privacy, security and reputational risks from AI.
These policies aim to clarify which AI uses are allowed in coursework so academic integrity is upheld.
The guidance is not a formal policy or mandate but a set of guardrails.
These policies set out what students need to know about permitted and prohibited AI use.
